name: Saudi Chemical Holding Company
summary: Saudi Chemical Holding Company is a diversified enterprise with operations in explosives, pharmaceuticals, and the production of ammonium nitrate, serving markets within Saudi Arabia and globally. The company manufactures and sells explosive materials and their derivatives for both civil and military purposes, complemented by specialized technical support services for explosive operations. Furthermore, it is deeply involved in the medical sector, encompassing the manufacturing, wholesale distribution, and retail of a broad array of products. This includes medicines, medical materials, syrups, pharmaceutical preparations, medical and surgical instruments, supplies for hospitals and healthcare centers, associated spare parts, and food items. Another core industrial activity is the production of ammonium nitrate. Established in 1972, Saudi Chemical Holding Company's headquarters are located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
